references.text: A cloud covered the mountain, and the glory of the Lord rested on Sinai. The cloud covered it for six days, and on the seventh day he called to Moses from the cloud.
The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You shall listen to him.
Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights! I have put my Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the nations.
And it shall come to pass on that day, that the Lord will again reach out his hand to win back the remnant of his people.
And behold, a voice from heaven said: This is my Son, the beloved, in whom I am well pleased.
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. And behold, a voice out of the cloud said: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him!
And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying: This is my Son, the chosen one. Listen to him!
